name: LinkedIn Ads
one_liner: Advertising API for programmatically managing LinkedIn ad accounts, campaigns, creatives and reporting.
auth_notes: 3-legged member OAuth. Scopes are per product (for example r_ads, rw_ads, r_ads_reporting). The authenticating member needs an ad account role such as ACCOUNT_MANAGER or CAMPAIGN_MANAGER.
access_notes: Advertising API is a vetted product with Development and Standard tiers, applied for via the increasing-access link. Every app starts at Development; Standard requires a support ticket. Ad accounts must be Enterprise or Business. No price is stated in the cached pages.

buildability.rationale: Advertising API access is vetted and granted at LinkedIn's discretion, and the Standard tier needs a support ticket. Developers cannot self-serve production credentials. Member OAuth and REST endpoints are documented.

identity.quote: The Advertising API enables developers to manage LinkedIn's campaign management platform on behalf of clients through APIs.

auth.quote: All permissions listed are Member Permissions (3-legged OAuth), meaning they require an authenticated LinkedIn member to grant consent
Run any OAuth flow that grants the scopes r_ads, rw_ads, r_ads_reporting

access.quote: Vetted Product with development and standard tiers
The Standard API Access must be requested via a support ticket to be submitted on the Developer Support Portal.

api_surface.quote: If you've tried calling LinkedIn's /rest/adAnalytics endpoint by hand

mcp.quote: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the LinkedIn Marketing API.

buildability.quote: LinkedIn reserves the right to review applications and select partners at its discretion

needs_human_reason: Whether LinkedIn approves Advertising API access is discretionary and not self-serve. Confirm with LinkedIn Developer Support before committing to a build.
